grid.frame: model metres (villa scene frame, z=0 = GF FFL)
grid.indexing: rows[j][i]: j along model y from ORIGIN_Y, i along model x from ORIGIN_X
grid.client_naming: north (street) = model -x; east = +y; south = +x; west (sister plot) = -y

method: Direct beam from each cell centre 0.05 m above its surface to the sun, against the opaque enclosure triangles used by concept/garden_sun.py (building, fences, yard wall, neighbours 12 m, sister, apartment, steps block, slabs); glass excluded; plants, pergola, furniture absent. NOAA solar position (archpipe.solar). 15-minute steps, sampled at mid-interval, each sunlit sample = 0.25 h.
time_basis: local STANDARD time = UTC+2 (as garden_sun). 'dst_clock' = the same clock hours read on a UTC+3 clock (gap S7).

location.source: villa_env.py: client maps link resolved 2026-09-25 - plot-level, NOT surveyed
location.placeholder_status: spec/villa-site.yaml holds 30.050/31.000 'city-level' EXAMPLE values; they are placeholders and are NOT used. Sensitivity (see sensitivity_vs_yaml_placeholder) is small.

units: hours of direct sun (shade = window length minus sun)

windows.summer_evening_17_20_dst_clock: 17:00-20:00 on a UTC+3 clock = 16:00-19:00 standard, 3 h, 21 June

g6_loquat_run_east_wall_y-20.65_x24.55-2.quoted_G6_report: east boundary of the south garden, five root-height points: mean 6.4 / 3.0 / 2.4 h (June / March / December), hourly

sanity.g2_report: 'North has only four/five hours [June], East has nine sampled hours' at the then-authored plant positions

gaps.text: Site latitude/longitude: sun layers use villa_env (client maps link, resolved 2026-09-25) - plot-level but not surveyed. spec/villa-site.yaml holds city-level PLACEHOLDER values; sensitivity is reported in sun.json.

Egypt's summer clock (DST, UTC+3) is not in any held source here. 'Summer evening 17:00-20:00' is given on the project's standard time AND as the same clock hours read on a DST clock; the client should say which they mean.
Plants, pergola, pots, furniture and the current garden's beds/paths are excluded from every layer (they are the thing being designed). Canopy shade from existing planting does not exist yet.
